content.rendered: If you plan to purchase your school supplies via your favorite online or local merchant, here is the 2023-2024 Hawks View Supply List. If there are any families that need financial assistance purchasing school supplies, please reach out to our school counselor, Sydney Allred at shustler@sherwood.k12.or.us.
